Consider the following reaction at equilibrium
$2F{e}^{2 +} ( aq ) + C{u}^{2 +} \to 2F{e}^{3 +} ( aq ) + Cu$

When the equilibrium is attained in cell reaction, the cell will no longer do any electrical work, i.e., $\DeltaG = 0$
$- \DeltaG = n{E}_{cell}F$
So $0 = n{E}_{cell}F$
or ${E}_{cell} = 0$ .
